column11: derived: SNY turned 16.69% of revenue into free cash over 2023 to 2025 against the 25.5% its filed expense lines leave. Restated before interest: SNY paid 1,631mm EUR of interest inside operating cash flow over 2023 to 2025, 1.33% of revenue. The free cash flow above is struck after it and the valuation already charges the debt by subtracting net debt, so the charge falls by that much, from 10.45% to 9.12%. Checked at replacement capex: no plant depreciation on file for every year, and no amortisation line to take it out of the combined figure, so the charge stands. Checked without one-off cash: deal payments are booked under investing, so free cash flow never carried them, and no settlement or transition tax is stated for the window, so the charge stands. Left out: 350mm USD of legal settlement in 2025, printed only in USD, rather than converted. Restated without working capital build: over 2023 to 2025 SNY's cash flow statement shows receivables up 1,702mm EUR, inventories up 1,382mm EUR, payables up 1,445mm EUR, a working capital build of 1,639mm EUR, 1.34% of revenue. Growth ties that cash up once, not on every product for ever, so the charge falls from 9.12% to 7.53%. Struck on total revenue: Sanofi's filed cost lines sit against net sales of EUR 43,626mm and other revenues of EUR 3,090mm together (FY2025 20-F 0001628280-26-008403, Note D.34.2), so each ratio is scaled by 43,626 over 46,716 and charged on every revenue the model carries. The book's costs are the filed ones either way; this shares them across the revenue that earned them. With the four rows written here indication_layer.build moves from five missing keys to two, eligible_pct and penetration_peak_pct (verified on a scratch copy of the book, 2026-11-16). eligible_pct would need the share of paediatric prurigo nodularis that is moderate to severe with a worst-itch score of 7 or more, which is NCT06293053's entry bar (IGA PN-S of 2 or more, at least 6 pruriginous lesions on at least 2 body surface areas, average worst itch of 7 or more); no free source gives a paediatric severity split, and the 2024 multicentre paediatric series says why - Kyvayko R, Fachler-Sharp T, Greenberger S, Horev A, Molho-Pessach V, Acta Derm Venereol 2024;104:adv15771, PMC10847973: 'To date, there is a lack of data regarding paediatric PN including demographic and epidemiological features, clinical manifestations, treatments and response to treatments.' penetration_peak_pct has no anchor either: Sanofi reports one Dupixent revenue line across nine indications, so no per-indication adult PN capture can be measured to carry across. AND THE STUDY IS A BRIDGE, NOT AN EFFICACY TRIAL: 18 participants, open label, single arm, primary outcome 'Concentration of dupilumab in serum' (ClinicalTrials.gov API v2, read 2026-11-16), so whoever lands those two keys should price a label extension under PREA rather than a new claim
